result.summary: issue-105 localized: an error-path-only TEMP_DIAGNOSTIC wrapper around radialAqueousConductanceM3PerH shows the hour-3,289 failure at site oxygen_soil_to_surface, root 2 / soil layer 2, with radius_m=0 and area_per_radius_m=0 while root aqueous volume (5.28e-6) and surface area (5.35e-4) are positive. The pre-registered prediction is confirmed. Cause: water_balance.zig writes root geometry only after six continue guards (density, axes, rooted fraction, water, matrix volume, conductivity), but the gas consumer visits any root with volume and area. Legacy uptake.f:526-538 always defines RRADL/PATH/RTARR (else RRAD2M, DLYR, 6.283*RTLGP), ungated by water or conductivity. No fix yet. Frontier unchanged (3,288). No gate promoted.
